1.

No condemnation is there now For us, thus saith God. In Christ we pure are found, And stand in holy garb.

2.

With the Father speaks Jesus’ blood For those He has redeemed; Them as jewels now He bears Continually upon His breast.

3.

O, what inexpressible grace: No more condemnation; For through Jesus’ precious wounds We are healed.

4.

Ah, teach us, Lord, more to see Upon Thee, God’s sacrifice Lamb, That we Thy love may comprehend And praise Thy name on high.
